honeygrain.name: Honeygrain Paste
honeygrain.description: Freshwater blend: attracts River Sprat, Russet River Chub and Olive Lake Perch. Does not alter feeding windows.

moonmoth.name: Moonmoth Lure
moonmoth.description: Freshwater scent: attracts Midnight Glassfin, Violet Lake Eel and Bluebar Trout. Night-only fish still require night.

saltflash.name: Saltflash Strips
saltflash.description: Ocean only: attracts Copperback Mackerel, Squallfin Marlin and Pelagic Monarch. Rain requirements still apply.

kelp_crumble.name: Kelp Crumble
kelp_crumble.description: Ocean only: attracts Blue Spiny Lobster, Copper Reef Lobster and Crown Reef Crab; ideal for cages.

roe.name: Fish Roe
roe.description: Cages/baskets only: attracts ocean lobsters and crabs plus freshwater crayfish. Craft with one ordinary Common/Uncommon kept rod fish and River Mint. Displayed fish, favourites and trophies are protected.
